_info: Banco de Error Killer. Cada error tiene su regla y sus ejercicios. Tipos: 'mc' (opción múltiple: 'options' + 'answer') y 'fill' (completar: 'answers' = lista de respuestas aceptadas). Los 'id' de ejercicios deben ser únicos.

errors.title: for + ago
errors.explanation: «for» + duración = cuánto tiempo duró algo (for three years). «ago» = cuánto tiempo atrás pasó algo, con pasado simple (I joined three years ago). «since» + punto de inicio (since 2022).

examples.wrong: I worked at Concentrix for three years ago.
examples.right: I worked at Concentrix for three years.

examples.wrong: I started for two years ago.
examples.right: I started two years ago.

exercises.prompt: I worked at Concentrix ___ three years.
I started at Concentrix three years ___.
¿Cuál es correcta?
options: I joined Veinsa Motors six months ago.
I joined Veinsa Motors for six months ago.
I joined Veinsa Motors since six months.
I joined Veinsa Motors six months before ago.
exercises.answer: I joined Veinsa Motors six months ago.

exercises.prompt: I did my internship at Veinsa Motors ___ six months.

options: I've been working in customer service for three years.

I've been working in customer service since three years.
I'm working in customer service for three years ago.
exercises.answer: I've been working in customer service for three years.

errors.title: interest → interested
errors.rule: Para decir lo que te atrae: siempre «-ed» → I'm interested in…
errors.explanation: «interested» (con -ed) describe cómo te sentís vos. «interesting» (con -ing) describe la cosa: The role is interesting. «interest» sin terminación es sustantivo o verbo. Lo mismo con excited/exciting, tired/tiring, satisfied. Y la preposición es «in»: interested in.

examples.wrong: I'm interest in this position.
examples.right: I'm interested in this position.

examples.wrong: I'm interesting in logistics.
examples.right: I'm interested in logistics.

errors.title: listen to + needs
errors.rule: «listen» siempre lleva «to» antes del objeto, y con clientes se habla de «needs», no «necessity».
errors.explanation: listen to someone / listen to something. «necessity» es algo indispensable en sentido abstracto o formal (a basic necessity). Para lo que un cliente o jefe necesita: needs → listen to their needs, meet their needs, understand their needs.

examples.wrong: I listen all their necessity.
examples.right: I listen to their needs.

examples.wrong: I listened the customer.
examples.right: I listened to the customer.

options: I listened to their needs and offered options.

errors.title: No resbalar al presente (narrando en pasado)
errors.rule: Si empezaste la historia en pasado, se queda en pasado hasta el final.
errors.explanation: Revisá cada verbo de la historia: started, took, handled, was, called. El presente solo vuelve al final si hablás de algo que hacés HOY gracias a esa experiencia: «Now I always double-check…».

examples.wrong: Last year the team was behind, so we take more time per call.
examples.right: Last year the team was behind, so we started taking more time per call.

examples.wrong: The shipment was late, so I call the broker.
examples.right: The shipment was late, so I called the broker.

errors.title: labor → worked
errors.rule: «labor» = trabajo físico pesado o el parto. Para esfuerzo profesional: worked / worked hard.
errors.explanation: «Laborar» en español no se traduce como «to labor». En inglés, «labor» suena a fábrica o campo (manual labor) o al parto (she went into labor). En la oficina: I worked on…, I worked hard to…, I made an effort to…

examples.wrong: We labor to improve our response times.
examples.right: We worked to improve our response times.

examples.wrong: I labored at Veinsa Motors.
examples.right: I worked at Veinsa Motors.

exercises.prompt: We ___ to improve our response times.
¿Cuál suena profesional?
options: I worked hard to reduce errors in the purchase orders.
I labored to reduce errors in the purchase orders.
I labor to reduce errors in the purchase orders.

exercises.answer: I worked hard to reduce errors in the purchase orders.

errors.title: partners → colleagues
errors.rule: «partner» = socio/dueño, pareja o empresa aliada. Compañeros de trabajo = colleagues / coworkers / teammates.
errors.explanation: Si decís «my partners» en una entrevista, suena a que eras dueña del negocio o a que hablás de tu pareja. En una consultora como BCG, «Partner» es literalmente el cargo más alto. Para tus compañeros: colleagues, coworkers, teammates, my team.

examples.wrong: I helped my partners with difficult calls.
examples.right: I helped my colleagues with difficult calls.

examples.wrong: My partners and I covered the shift.
examples.right: My teammates and I covered the shift.

exercises.prompt: I trained two of my ___ on the new Salesforce process.
¿Cuál es correcta?
options: My colleagues and I covered the extra shifts.
My partners and I covered the extra shifts.
My companions and I covered the extra shifts.
My partner's and I covered the extra shifts.
exercises.answer: My colleagues and I covered the extra shifts.

exercises.prompt: I often helped my ___ when they had difficult calls.

Empresa aliada: Our logistics ___ in Panama handled the transshipment.

Tell me about a conflict at work. — I disagreed with a ___ about how to prioritize the queue.
I'll loop in my ___ from the customs team.

errors.title: different + plural
errors.rule: Después de different / several / many / various / multiple, el sustantivo va en plural. «different» nunca lleva -s.
errors.explanation: En español también es plural («diferentes plataformas»), pero al hablar rápido la -s se cae. Pronunciala a propósito: platform-S, account-S. Y ojo: el adjetivo no cambia → different (nunca «differents»).

examples.wrong: I used different platform.
examples.right: I used different platforms.

examples.wrong: I handled differents accounts.
examples.right: I handled different accounts.

exercises.prompt: I used different ___: Salesforce, Oracle and Genesys.

Elegí la forma correcta:

errors.title: to + verbo base
errors.rule: Después de «to» (want to, need to, asked to, in order to…) va el verbo base: to submit, to send.
errors.explanation: El infinitivo en inglés es «to + verbo sin cambios». Nada de -ing ni -ed después. Excepción famosa: cuando «to» es preposición, va -ing → I look forward to hearing from you. Para entrevistas, memorizá esa frase entera.

examples.wrong: I needed to submitting the forms.
examples.right: I needed to submit the forms.

examples.wrong: I used Oracle to tracking orders.
examples.right: I used Oracle to track orders.

errors.title: Understood → Sure
errors.rule: Al responder un pedido, «Understood» suena militar. Usá: Sure · Of course · Will do · Got it · Sounds good.
errors.explanation: «Understood» es como decir «Entendido, mi capitán»: seco y jerárquico. En una oficina en EE. UU. suena más natural: Sure / Of course (te piden algo), Will do (una tarea), Got it (información), Sounds good (un plan), Thanks for the heads-up (un aviso).

examples.wrong: Can you book the room? — Understood.
examples.right: Can you book the room? — Sure, I'll book it now.

examples.wrong: The meeting moved to 3. — Understood.
examples.right: The meeting moved to 3. — Got it, thanks.

errors.title: in Oracle
errors.rule: Sistemas y programas llevan «in»: in Oracle, in Salesforce, in the system. El nombre va solo, sin «the system».
errors.explanation: in = dentro de un sistema o programa (in Oracle, in Excel, in TICA). at = lugar o empresa (at Concentrix, at BCG). on = teléfono o llamada (on the phone, on a call). No traduzcas «en el sistema Oracle»: decí simplemente «in Oracle».

examples.wrong: I created the orders at the system Oracle.
examples.right: I created the orders in Oracle.

examples.wrong: I worked in Concentrix.
examples.right: I worked at Concentrix.

exercises.prompt: I updated the customer's address ___ Salesforce.
¿Cuál es correcta?
options: I created purchase orders in Oracle.
I created purchase orders at the system Oracle.
I created purchase orders at Oracle system.
I created purchase orders in the system Oracle.
exercises.answer: I created purchase orders in Oracle.

errors.title: we → I cuando lo hiciste vos
errors.rule: En entrevistas, cuando contás lo que VOS hiciste, usá «I». «We» borra tu mérito.
errors.explanation: El entrevistador está evaluándote a vos, no a tu equipo. Usá «we» o «our team» solo para el contexto («Our team had a backlog of 200 cases»), y «I» para cada acción y resultado tuyo («I proposed…», «I reduced…»).

examples.wrong: We built a checklist and reduced errors.
examples.right: I built a checklist, and that reduced errors by 30%.

examples.wrong: We called the broker.
examples.right: I called the broker.

exercises.prompt: Tell me about a time you solved a problem. ¿Qué frase de Action te da el mérito?
options: I created a tracker to follow up on every pending order.
We created a tracker to follow up on every pending order.
They created a tracker to follow up on every pending order.
A tracker was created to follow up on every pending order.
exercises.answer: I created a tracker to follow up on every pending order.

exercises.prompt: What did you do when the shipment was delayed?
options: I contacted the broker and reorganized the delivery schedule.
We contacted the broker and reorganized the delivery schedule.
The team contacted the broker and reorganized the delivery schedule.
The broker was contacted and the schedule was reorganized.
exercises.answer: I contacted the broker and reorganized the delivery schedule.

exercises.prompt: Our team had a backlog of 200 cases, so ___ proposed a new triage process.
¿Qué frase te da crédito a vos?
options: I trained three new agents on the loan process.
We trained three new agents on the loan process.
New agents were trained on the loan process.
There was training for three new agents.
exercises.answer: I trained three new agents on the loan process.

exercises.prompt: How did you handle an angry customer?
options: I listened to her concerns and offered a payment plan.
We listened to her concerns and offered a payment plan.
Her concerns were listened to and a plan was offered.
We listen to her concerns and offer a payment plan.
exercises.answer: I listened to her concerns and offered a payment plan.

exercises.prompt: ___ reviewed every purchase order before it went to the supplier.
¿Cuál usa «we/our team» bien (solo contexto) y «I» para la acción?
options: Our team was handling 300 calls a day, so I suggested a callback system.
We was handling 300 calls a day, so I suggested a callback system.
Our team was handling 300 calls a day, so we suggested a callback system.
I was handling 300 calls a day, so our team suggested a callback system.
exercises.answer: Our team was handling 300 calls a day, so I suggested a callback system.

exercises.prompt: Tell me about a time you took initiative.
options: I noticed the customs forms had repeated errors, so I built a checklist.
We noticed the customs forms had repeated errors, so we built a checklist.
Errors were noticed and a checklist was built.
The team noticed errors, so they built a checklist.
exercises.answer: I noticed the customs forms had repeated errors, so I built a checklist.

exercises.prompt: When my manager was double-booked, ___ rescheduled the less urgent meeting.
Result:
options: As a result, I reduced documentation errors by 30%.
As a result, we reduced documentation errors by 30%.
As a result, errors were reduced.
As a result, the team reduce errors.
exercises.answer: As a result, I reduced documentation errors by 30%.

exercises.prompt: I worked with the finance team, and ___ personally handled the reconciliation.
___ took ownership of the escalated cases.
¿Cuál es la mejor frase para tu CV oral?
options: I coordinated with suppliers in Japan and Germany to confirm delivery dates.
We coordinated with suppliers in Japan and Germany to confirm delivery dates.
Coordination with suppliers in Japan and Germany was done.
Suppliers in Japan and Germany were coordinated.
exercises.answer: I coordinated with suppliers in Japan and Germany to confirm delivery dates.

exercises.prompt: My supervisor asked me for help, so ___ created a step-by-step guide.
What was your role?
options: I was responsible for verifying the import documents.
We were responsible for verifying the import documents.
exercises.answer: I was responsible for verifying the import documents.
